name: Crocodile
publication: Black Flag Roleplaying Reference Document v0.2
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception 10. Stealth 12. Resistant to charmed. No listed special senses or languages.
appearance: A heavy crocodile with a tapered snout, interlocking teeth, dark olive-brown back scutes, and a long armored tail.

sections.Printed source:
Kobold Press, Black Flag Roleplaying Reference Document v0.2, May 2024, p. 355. 
XP from the Experience Points by Challenge Rating table, p. 229.
sections.Ability modifiers: STR +2 · DEX +0 · CON +1 · INT −4 · WIS +0 · CHA −3
sections.Traits: Hold Breath. The crocodile can go 15 minutes without taking a breath.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit against one creature within 5 ft. A hit deals 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage and grapples the creature (escape DC 12). The target stays restrained until that grapple ends, and the crocodile can bite only the held target while the grapple lasts.
sections.Bonus actions: Death Roll. The crocodile chooses one creature it is grappling. The creature makes a DC 12 Strength save and takes 5 (2d4) slashing damage on a failure, or half on a success.
sections.At the table: Charmed resistance grants advantage on checks and saves to avoid or end that condition. Apply Death Roll with a bonus action against prey already grappled.

name: Crocodile

sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), Appendix A, printed p. 320, Crocodile. https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/basic-rules-2014/monster-stat-blocks-c#Crocodile
sections.Traits: Hold Breath. The crocodile can go 15 minutes without taking a breath.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit against one creature within 5 ft. A hit deals 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage and grapples the creature (escape DC 12). The target stays restrained until that grapple ends, and the crocodile can bite only the held target while the grapple lasts.
sections.At the table: Resolve the grapple when Bite hits. The grappled creature can use its action to make the escape check.

name: Mastiff
publication: Black Flag Roleplaying Reference Document v0.2
otherStatistics: Perception 11. Stealth 12. No listed special senses or languages.
appearance: A broad-chested fawn guard dog with a black muzzle, dark folded ears, thick neck, and strong paws.

sections.Printed source:
Kobold Press, Black Flag Roleplaying Reference Document v0.2, May 2024, pp. 363–364. 
XP from the Experience Points by Challenge Rating table, p. 229.
sections.Ability modifiers: STR +1 · DEX +2 · CON +1 · INT −4 · WIS +1 · CHA −2
sections.Traits: Heightened Hearing and Smell. Use Perception 16 for hearing or scent.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit against one target within 5 ft. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage. A creature hit must pass a DC 12 Strength save to stay standing.
sections.Reactions: Protect Friend. When a friendly Humanoid the mastiff can see is hit by an attack from a creature within 5 ft. of the mastiff, the mastiff can make one Bite attack against that attacker.
sections.At the table: Measure the 5-ft. range from the mastiff to the attacker. The mastiff must see the friendly Humanoid who was hit.

name: Mule
publication: Black Flag Roleplaying Reference Document v0.2
otherStatistics: Perception 10. Stealth 10. Resistant to exhaustion and prone. No listed special senses or languages.
appearance: A brown mule with tall donkey-like ears, a short dark mane, a grey muzzle, and narrow hooves.

sections.Printed source:
Kobold Press, Black Flag Roleplaying Reference Document v0.2, May 2024, p. 364. 
XP from the Experience Points by Challenge Rating table, p. 229.
sections.Ability modifiers: STR +2 · DEX +0 · CON +1 · INT −4 · WIS +0 · CHA −3
sections.Traits: Beast of Burden. Treat the mule as Large when calculating how much it can carry.
sections.Actions: Hooves. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit against one target within 5 ft. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.
sections.At the table: Resistance gives advantage on checks and saves to avoid or end exhaustion or the prone condition. The mule occupies a Medium space.

name: Octopus
publication: Black Flag Roleplaying Reference Document v0.2
otherStatistics: Perception 12. Stealth 13. Darkvision 30 ft. No listed languages.
appearance: A small mottled russet octopus with a rounded mantle, horizontal pupils, and eight curling arms lined with pale suckers.

sections.Printed source:
Kobold Press, Black Flag Roleplaying Reference Document v0.2, May 2024, p. 364. 
XP from the Experience Points by Challenge Rating table, p. 229.
sections.Ability modifiers: STR −3 · DEX +1 · CON +0 · INT −4 · WIS +0 · CHA −3
sections.Traits:
Hold Breath. Out of water, the octopus can go 30 minutes without taking a breath.
Underwater Camouflage. Use Stealth 18 underwater.
Water Breathing. Breathes only underwater.
sections.Actions: Tentacles. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit against one target within 5 ft. A hit deals 3 (1d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage and grapples a Medium or smaller creature (escape DC 11). Until that grapple ends, the octopus can use Tentacles only on the held target.
sections.Reactions: Ink Dash (Recharge 6). When a creature the octopus can see damages it underwater, the octopus can release an ink cloud in a 5-ft. radius around itself. The area is heavily obscured through the end of the octopus's next turn unless a strong current disperses the ink first. The octopus may then swim up to its swim speed. If it swims, it immediately releases any creature it is holding.
sections.At the table: After using Ink Dash, recharge it on a 6 on a d6 rolled at the start of each of the octopus's turns, or after a short or long rest.
